get.summary: The Events screen: each Series and the Rated Events inside it.
get.description: Series -> Rated Event, plus the Performance per Series chart and the Rated Events entered but never played. Each Rated Event here is a summary row with its Section placements; its full crosstables come from GET /api/v1/events/{event_id} (the web embeds them in the card; the app pushes a detail screen). Forfeit rule throughout: a Forfeit win counts toward score but never as a game, a win, or a Streak.

200.description: The Events screen for this filter state.

EventsPayload.description: Everything the Events page shows. Empty series is the 'No events in this filter' empty state; empty series_performance is the chart's empty state; empty unplayed_events hides that card. Source: pages/events.py update_event_bar -> pgn_stats_core.event_summary; update_series_groups -> uscf_core.series_summary(df_f, data.get_live_series(), data.get_uscf_events()) + pgn_stats_core.performance_rating_stats per UscfEventId + data.get_uscf_standings() / data.get_uscf_profile().member_id for placements; update_unplayed -> uscf_core.unplayed_events(data.get_df(), data.get_uscf_events(), start, end).

series_performance.description: The Performance per Series stacked W/D/L bar chart: the 20 most recent Series by first Game date, oldest first (the web draws the list reversed, newest on top). Forfeits count here, as in event_summary. Games with an empty Series are left out.

series.description: Series -> Rated Events groups, oldest first by first Game date (undated Series last).

unplayed_events.description: The 'Entered, never played' card: Rated Events the player entered with no Games anywhere in the UNFILTERED store (no-shows, online-only events). Only the start/end filters apply, to the event's start date; undated events always show.

EventsSeriesBar.description: One bar of the Performance per Series chart; the hover shows each count.

EventsSeries.description: One Series (the PGN Event header) as an expandable group. Header: '<game_count> games, <forfeit_count> forfeits, <win>W <draw>D <loss>L, <score> pts, best streak <longest_win_streak>W' (forfeits shown only when nonzero, the streak only when >= 2).

game_count.description: Games played over the board (Forfeits excluded).

win.description: Wins over the board (Forfeits excluded); likewise draw and loss.

score.description: Tournament points: wins + 0.5 x draws + Forfeit wins. Halves are possible.

longest_win_streak.description: The longest Streak of wins in this Series, date order, Forfeits excluded.

rated_events.description: The Rated Events this Series' matched Games belong to, chronological by start date (undated last).

unmatched_games.description: The 'Not part of any Rated Event' block: Games in this Series with no Rated Event (Forfeits and Games USCF hasn't rated yet). Empty hides the block.

EventsRatedEvent.description: One Rated Event card inside a Series. Tap pushes GET /api/v1/events/{event_id} for its crosstables.

event_id.description: The USCF event ID; the path key of the event route.

player_count.description: The Rated Event's whole field, from USCF; null when unknown.

sections.description: The Sections this Series' Games were played in, sorted by name, each with the final placement when its crosstable is cached.

pre_rating.description: Live Rating walking in (before the first played Section), whole number; null when unrated or no Live series point.

post_rating.description: Live Rating walking out (after the last played Section), whole number; null when unknown. With pre_rating null and post_rating set, the web shows 'unrated -> <post>'.

rating_change.description: round(post) - round(pre) of the Live Rating; null when either is null. Independent of the lens (always the Live series, as on the web).

performance_rating.description: Performance rating over this Rated Event's filtered Games (pgn_stats_core.performance_rating_stats, Forfeits and unrated opponents excluded); null when none qualify.

games.description: This Rated Event's Games, in date then round order.

EventsSectionPlacement.description: One Section the player played, with the crosstable summary line 'Finished <placement> of <player_count>'.

has_crosstable.description: Whether the crosstable for (event_id, name) is cached. False: placement and player_count are null and the detail screen shows no crosstable for it.

placement.description: The player's final ordinal in the Section (1 = Section winner); null when no crosstable or the player's member ID isn't in it.

player_count.description: Rows in the Section's crosstable; null when no crosstable.

EventsGameRow.description: One Game line inside a Rated Event or the unmatched block: 'R<round> <color> <outcome> vs <opponent> <opponent_rating>' plus a Forfeit marker. Tap opens GET /api/v1/games/{game.game_id}.

round.description: The REAL round from the cached crosstable (UscfRound) when known, falling back to the hand-typed Round header (RoundNum); null shows as a dash. May differ from game.round, which is the typed one.

EventsUnplayedEvent.description: One entered-but-never-played Rated Event. Not tappable (it has no Games, so the event route 404s for it).
